lever: phase-asymmetric sims split (tile vs meeple budget within a turn) — docs/LEVER_INDEX.md

world_draw.semantics: fair_agent.FairHeuristicMCTSAgent.reshuffled_determinization (canonical sort of the UNSEEN deck + rng.shuffle; next_tile untouched)
world_draw.seed_lineage: adaptive_k_census.world_seed(deck_seed, ply, salt) -> agent seed; det_rng = Random(agent.det_seed_base(0)+1); worlds drawn ONCE, reused at every rung (CRN)
world_draw.salt_note: disjoint from the adaptive-k census (20260728) and the CL-070 tag/probe salts (9000/9001)
world_draw.limitation: distributionally-equivalent redraw, not the literal in-game worlds (the bank records no per-game agent seed)

search.note: reference rung = PRODUCTION per-world budget; the ladder is the SAME k worlds searched at each rung (only sims differ)

latch_band.rule: TURN-ATOMIC: TILES k<=K solver-owned; MEEPLES k+1<=K (its turn's tile decision latched; engine pre-draws next tile during MEEPLES). Blanket k<=K also recorded per row for adaptive-k joinability.

rules_epoch_note: bank is walled-era self-play (pre-fixed_v1); replay matches the generating rules (checksum-enforced). The sims contrast is within-root, so the epoch offsets the position distribution, not the contrast.

execution.backend_resolution: resolved at launch by rust_world_search.resolve_backend (escape hatch: CARC_PROBE_FORCE_PYTHON=1)
execution.threads_note: per-world search_single is SINGLE-THREADED; these probes are game-parallel farms, so rust_threads applies only to the whole-agent parity check
execution.seam: ONE determinized world's search (fair_agent.search_one_world -> MirrorState.search_single). Determinization draw, pooling (_merge_root_stats) and decision rule (pooled_q_argmax) stay in Python and are the SAME function objects on both backends.

gap_status.gap1_search_seed: CLOSED — measurement/rustport_p6/GAP1_SEED_INVARIANCE.json; the per-world seed det_seed_base+100+i is inert
gap_status.gap2_reuse_tree: inert — every per-world search is fresh-tree on both backends
gap_status.gap3_evaluator_injection: enforced — search_config_rs raises on any python-only search variant

execution.determinism_control: every 1 roots — python: different-seed re-search (adaptive-k control); rust: same-call repeat (run-to-run determinism; carc_rs has no search seed, seed-invariance proven in measurement/rustport_p6/GAP1_SEED_INVARIANCE.json)
